headline: Oil Rises To 103.7 From 103.19 As The Gain Widens To 4.25 Percent
narrative: Oil rose to 103.7 from 103.19, and the gain widened to 4.25 percent from 3.74 percent. The oil pipe is the cash price of crude, so the higher print means crude cash value rose against the prior reading and the day's advance widened. Gold is at 4,014, down 1.14 percent, and silver is at 54.08, down 1.26 percent, so the bid is in crude rather than bullion.
author: jordan
